title: Position Bias · PAL (Position-Aware Learning)
prompt: How do you solve the **Position Bias** problem in search and feeds (users click slot #1 regardless of relevance)? Explain **PAL (Position-Aware Learning)**: feeding `position_id` as a feature into a separate shallow tower during training and setting `position_id = 0` for all items during inference.

resources.title: Handle and Mitigate Position Bias in Machine Learning Systems
resources.why: Position bias in click data, PAL-style two-part models and practical mitigations.
